findings.explanation: Dell EMC storage has nothing to do with an executive KPI scorecard.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: revenue_mtd uses `earliest=-1mon@mon`, which snaps to the start of the previous month. The value is therefore last month plus month-to-date, not MTD. Use `earliest=@mon`, or a fiscal-period POPER filter.

In ACDOCA, revenue postings are credits stored as negative HSL/KSL values. `sum(HSL)` on revenue accounts would then be negative, so `current_value>=threshold_amber` is never met and the tile is always RED. `^4[0-9]{4,6}` also assumes RACCT has no leading zeros, but SAP stores numeric G/L accounts as zero-padded CHAR(10). Check both against the S/4HANA extract.

The BLART filter includes RE (in SAP standard, the MM vendor invoice) and DZ (customer payment), which are not revenue documents, and leaves out DR (customer invoice). Confirm the document types with controlling.

pipeline_coverage is calculated as open pipeline ÷ won amount over 90 days. Coverage is normally open pipeline ÷ remaining quota/target. The salesforce:opportunity snapshots are also not deduped by Id, so repeated polls of the same opportunity inflate both open and won sums.

`sum(eval(band="P"))` sums a Boolean comparison. The usual idiom is `count(eval(band="P"))`, so check that sum returns counts rather than null. Missing scores are also coalesced to "0" and counted as detractors.

summary: A sensible executive-scorecard design with good troubleshooting content. However, the SPL's KPI math has several finance-level errors (MTD window, revenue sign and account filter, pipeline coverage formula, no snapshot dedup), and the detailed implementation is bolded word by word to the point of being unreadable, with leftover generator instructions.
